rabbi-chiyya-bar-abba.name: Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba
rabbi-chiyya-bar-abba.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who settled in the Land of Israel and transmitted many teachings of Rabbi Yoḥanan.
rabbi-chiyya-bar-abba.prompt: A devoted student-scholar in his 40s with a dark brown beard and attentive eyes, a Babylonian who settled in the Land of Israel; plain grey-brown wool mantle, a wax tablet in his hand. Tiberian limestone arches and olive trees behind him.

rav-huna-bar-manoach.name: Rav Huna bar Manoaḥ
rav-huna-bar-manoach.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits teachings of Rav Aḥa son of Rav Ika.
rav-huna-bar-manoach.prompt: A scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a quiet, studious look, in a plain brown wool mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

rav-acha-brei-derav-ika.name: Rav Aḥa son of Rav Ika
rav-acha-brei-derav-ika.bio: Babylonian Amora whose teachings are cited by Rav Huna bar Manoaḥ.
rav-acha-brei-derav-ika.prompt: A senior scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a grave, thoughtful expression, in a dark olive wool mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

ravina.name: Ravina
ravina.bio: Babylonian Amora, a younger colleague and student of Rava.
ravina.prompt: A youthful scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and an eager, questioning expression, in a blue-grey linen mantle. Palm groves along the Euphrates behind him.

rav-yehuda.name: Rav Yehuda
rav-yehuda.bio: Rav Yehuda bar Yeḥezkel, student of Rav and Shmuel and founder of the academy at Pumbedita.
rav-yehuda.prompt: A dignified, exacting teacher in his 60s with a full grey beard, known for his careful, refined speech; deep green wool mantle. Mudbrick academy walls of Pumbedita and oil lamps behind him.

rabbi-yitzchak.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak
rabbi-yitzchak.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, cited in the Talmud by this name alone.
rabbi-yitzchak.prompt: A scholar in his 50s with a greying brown beard and a warm, expressive face, in a russet wool mantle, a scroll under one arm. Galilean limestone arches and olive trees behind him.

rabba.name: Rabba
rabba.bio: Rabba bar Naḥmani, head of the academy at Pumbedita and teacher of Abaye.
rabba.prompt: A keen, intense scholar in his 50s, famed as an “uprooter of mountains” for his sharp reasoning; dark beard streaked with grey, piercing eyes, deep indigo mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps of Pumbedita behind him.

rav-zevid.name: Rav Zevid
rav-zevid.prompt: A composed scholar in his 50s with a neat dark beard, in a teal-grey wool mantle. Palm groves along the Euphrates behind him.

rabbi-abbahu.name: Rabbi Abbahu
rabbi-abbahu.bio: Leading Amora of Caesarea and student of Rabbi Yoḥanan, known for his standing with the Roman authorities.
rabbi-abbahu.prompt: A handsome, distinguished man in his 50s with a well-groomed dark beard and a confident bearing, known for his good looks and his dealings with the Roman governors; fine cream linen robe under a rich purple mantle. Limestone colonnades of Caesarea by the sea behind him.

rabbi-yosei-bar-avin.name: Rabbi Yosei bar Avin
rabbi-yosei-bar-avin.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, also called Rabbi Yosei bar Bun.
rabbi-yosei-bar-avin.prompt: A scholar in his 40s with a short brown beard and a thoughtful look, in a sand-colored wool mantle. Galilean limestone arches and olive trees behind him.

chananya.name: Ḥananya
chananya.bio: Tanna cited in baraitot by this name alone.
chananya.prompt: A scholar in his 40s with a dark beard and an earnest expression, in an undyed wool mantle. The Yavne study hall behind him.
